info.name: FMLD MEMS (mems) — Full API
info.description:
Complete endpoint collection for the FMLD Monitoring & Evaluation backend (`mems`, Laravel 11).

**Two surfaces are covered:**

1. **Public / integration API** — `routes/api.php` + `routes/v1/*.php`, mounted at `{{api_url}}` (= `{{base_url}}/api/v1`). Auth is **JWT** (`tymon/jwt-auth`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer {{jwt_token}}`. The collection-level auth already does this — run **Auth → Sign In** once and the token is captured automatically.

2. **Internal (Inertia/Vue web app)** — `routes/web.php`. These are the endpoints the bundled Vue frontend calls. They use **session cookie auth** (`auth.web`) plus Laravel **CSRF**, not JWT. See the `Internal — Web App (Session Auth)` folder description for the login + CSRF flow.

**Conventions**
- Every host/path segment that varies is an environment variable — nothing is hard-coded.
- Optional query params are included but *disabled*; tick them in Postman to use them.
- Request bodies mirror the controllers' `validate()` rules exactly (required fields present, optional ones included with sample values).

Generated from source: `routes/api.php`, `routes/web.php`, `routes/v1/{auth,user,supervisor-enumerator,indicator-reporting,web-indicator-reporting,web-supervisor-enumerator}.php`.

item.name: Internal — Web App (Session Auth)
item.description:
**Everything below is the Inertia/Vue web app's own surface (`routes/web.php`), not the public API.**

Auth model: cookie session (`auth.web`) + Laravel CSRF. To use these in Postman:

1. `GET {{web_url}}/login` — establishes the session and drops the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie.
2. `POST {{web_url}}/login` (the **Web Login** request below) with your credentials.
3. Every mutating request afterwards sends `X-XSRF-TOKEN: {{xsrf_token}}`; the collection pre-request script refreshes that variable from the cookie jar on every call.

Most of these return **Inertia HTML/redirects**, not JSON. Add `X-Inertia: true` and `X-Inertia-Version` if you want the JSON page payload; a handful (`/departments/{id}/children`, the `location/*` endpoints, `/api/dashboard/stats`, the broadcast/test routes, quick-add) return plain JSON regardless.

Inertia sends `PUT`/`DELETE` as real verbs — no `_method` spoofing is needed.

request.description: Middleware `guest.web`. Renders the `Login` Inertia page and sets the `XSRF-TOKEN` + session cookies. **Run this first.**
`Auth\LoginController@login`, middleware `guest.web`. Body: `email`, `password`, optional `remember` (bool). Regenerates the session on success.
Middleware `auth.web`. Invalidates the session and regenerates the CSRF token.
`DashboardController@index`, middleware `auth.web`.

⚠️ Lives at `/api/dashboard/stats` — **outside** the `/v1` group. Middleware: `EncryptCookies`, `AddQueuedCookiesToResponse`, `api.session.auth`, i.e. it authenticates via the **web session cookie**, not JWT. Log in via `Web Login` first.
Renders `Enumeration/NewEnumeration`.
